benchmark_type_evidence: We develop BenchMAX, a multi-way multilingual benchmark that covers 10 diverse tasks, to evaluate LLMs' general abilities across many languages. [...] We extend current datasets by translating English to other languages. [...] we introduce the Domain Translation task, a by-product of the BenchMAX construction.
brief_description: BenchMAX is a comprehensive multilingual evaluation suite covering 10 diverse tasks across 6 capabilities (instruction following, code generation, reasoning, long context understanding, tool use, and translation) in 17 languages. Data is machine-translated from English and post-edited by three native annotators per sample to ensure quality.
